# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

I don’t remember the email address on the order, but I can provide my name, address, and anything else you need to look it up.

I can help with that. First, I need to verify your account using your name and ZIP code.

Please provide your last name so I can locate your user ID.

Please provide your last name so I can locate your user ID.

- Name: Sofia Li
- Address: 786 Elm Street, Suite 546, San Antonio, TX 78260
- Email on file: sofia.li7352@example.com

To start the refund, I need to identify which delivered order contains the bicycle. Your orders are:
- #W4689314
- #W8855135
- #W3916020
- #W5416052

Please tell me which order is the bicycle order, and if you’re not sure, I can help check them one by one.
